authoritative_unit: modeled hourly simulation steps (NOT calendar time -- see PHASE8_DURATION_GAP_CLOSURE.md; the underlying dataset has real multi-week gaps that make calendar-time duration meaningless)
equivalent_clock_time_note: Because the canonical timestep is exactly 1 hour, a duration of N simulation steps is numerically equal to N hours of WALL-CLOCK time WITHIN a contiguous run of modeled hours (no dataset gap crossed). This equivalence is stated explicitly here per Section 9.8's instruction; it does not change the authoritative step-based unit.
